name: houdini_inspect
description: Ask THIS Houdini what it really exposes, in one call: search (words found in node type names and descriptions, parameter names and labels of every node type, and hou classes, functions and methods with their signature line; ranked), a node type (description, inputs min/max, outputs, parameter templates with the real parameter names, defaults, ranges and menu items, its HDA library and version, the SideFX page of this version), a live node (type, flags, inputs and outputs, errors/warnings/messages, changed parameters with values and expressions, children; a SOP's or geometry object's cooked geometry: points, prims, vertices, bbox, attributes per class, groups; a LOP's USD stage: prims and types; a TOP's work items; a ROP's output and frame range) and/or a hou symbol (its docstring signature and page). Entries beyond limit are still named. Always says the Houdini version and license. Read only.

type.description: A node type: Category/name (Sop/box, Lop/sphere, Object/geo, Driver/karma, Top/wedge) or a name with category.

category.description: Node type category (Sop, Lop, Object, Driver, Top, Dop, Vop, Cop...): for type without one, or to keep search to it.

node.description: A live node path, e.g. /obj/geo1/scatter1 or /stage/sublayer1.

hou.description: A hou path, e.g. hou.OpNode.createNode, hou.Geometry, hou.node.

match.description: Keep the parameters (and stage prims) matching: a glob on names (size*), or words found in name or label.

limit.description: Entries in detail (1 to 200); the others are named.
